annotations.title: Review score, level and new reviews

description: Answers "what's my score", "what's my level", "how many reviews have I got" or "any new reviews". Returns `spoken`, one short paragraph written to be read aloud, plus the score (average stars to one decimal, same maths as Nero Work), number of reviews, verified jobs, level (New, Level 5 at 10 jobs, Level 10 at 25, Level 25 at 75), jobs to the next level, a star breakdown, customers who have not reviewed yet, and the three newest reviews.
